item.title: Venice Biennale Announces Participating Artists, Christophe Leribault Poised to Replace Ousted Louvre President: Morning Links for February 25, 2026
item.description: Here's what we're reading this morning, folks.

item.title: The 2026 Venice Biennale Gets an Official Gin
item.description: Meet Quattro Gatti, an Umbria-based gin company founded by the Mordant family.

item.title: Christophe Leribault Tapped to Lead Louvre Museum One Day After Laurence Des Cars’s Resignation
item.description: Leribault most recently served as director of the Palace of Versailles.

item.title: Corinna Durland Joins kurimanzutto as Senior Director in New York
item.description: Durland brings more than two decades of experience working with artists, estates, collectors, and institutions.

item.title: High Museum COO Resigns After Alleged $600,000 Misappropriation, Case Referred to Federal Prosecutors
item.description: On Tuesday, the board of the Woodruff Arts Center, which oversees the High, voted to refer the matter to the U.S. Attorney’s Office for the Northern District of Georgia for possible criminal prosecution.

item.title: Ukraine Adopts New Resolution on Evacuating Museum Objects From Conflict Zones
item.description: The resolution aims to expedite the evacuation of more than three million cultural objects from frontline regions as Russia’s full-scale invasion approaches its fourth anniversary.

item.title: Éliane Radigue, Composer of Epochal Electronic Sounds, Dies at 94
item.description: She figured in the history of musique concrète and early electronic music beginning in the 1950s.

item.title: 35 Rembrandt Etchings Re-Discovered in a Family Home in the Netherlands
item.description: Charlotte Meyer's grandfather acquired the etchings in the early 1900s for "only a few guilders."

item.title: New York Historical to Receive Gift of Works by Native American Artists
item.description: The promised gift comes from NYH chair Dr. Agnes Hsu-Tang and her husband Oscar Tang.

item.title: Volunteer Group Documents Smithsonian Wall Text as Trump Administration Presses Cultural Review
item.description: The Trump administration has issued directives aimed at eliminating what it calls “improper ideology” in cultural institutions and has requested reviews of several Smithsonian museums.
